conclusion: At |F|=|G|=3 (K_{3,3}), boxt[F]=G is SUFFICIENT but NOT NECESSARY for w to be boxt_hat-fixed. The exact criterion is the meet criterion /\ boxt[F] = w (Lemma 118a). Sharp form (Thm 119c): fixed iff boxt[F] contains a meet-generating subfamily of G; equivalently |boxt[F] cap G| >= mu(w), the minimal meet-generator size. Here mu(w)=2 < 3=|G| (G meet-REDUNDANT), so necessity of onto fails; in the hexagon mu(w)=2=|G| (meet-IRREDUNDANT), so onto is forced. No fixing map has boxt[F] disjoint from G: at least 2 genuine upper-frontier elements are mandatory.
